# CoinDrop

> CoinDrop is a free Android app for earning crypto daily: claim airdrop rewards with one tap, complete simple tasks, refer friends and unlock Premium perks. Not coindrop.in.

CoinDrop, a CoinX project by GSPTeck, is published on Google Play as com.gspteck.coindrop. The official website is coindrop.website. CoinDrop is not coindrop.in, which is a separate, unrelated site.

The official Solana mint address published on the homepage is mntq6hnGWU9761TRZdzeAkhTmAuTUKRQqZe1D7787UV.

## What the app does

- Claim daily crypto rewards with one tap of a button.
- Complete simple tasks to earn more.
- Contribute to development and refer friends for extra rewards.
- Optional Premium membership: 100x button click rewards, secondary tokens, and infinite energy (no recovery wait). The free plan has 1x button click rewards, no secondary tokens, and 3 second energy recovery.
- A Premium price is not published on this site.
